title: Unsigned, sign-and-magnitude and two’s complement
description: Fixed width limits the representable values. A language’s type specifies how bits are to be interpreted. Sign-and-magnitude uses one sign bit and the remaining bits for magnitude, with two encodings of zero. In n-bit two’s complement, the high column has weight −2ⁿ⁻¹. The range is −2ⁿ⁻¹ to 2ⁿ⁻¹ − 1, with one zero.

title: Operating systems and kernels
description: An operating system allocates processor time and memory, controls access to devices and offers services to applications. Its kernel is the part that manages these resources directly. Windows and macOS are desktop examples. A Linux distribution packages the Linux kernel with tools and applications. Android also uses a Linux-based kernel. Small controllers can execute firmware directly.

title: Use locality to reason about caches
description: Later slides. On a hit the cache already has the requested data. On a miss a whole line is brought from the next level and an old line may be evicted. Temporal locality is reuse of the same location. Spatial locality is access to nearby locations. A write-back cache must preserve modified data when evicting it. Tags identify which source block a line holds.

title: Encoding and decoding UTF-8
description: Read the prefix to determine length. U+0000–007F uses 0xxxxxxx. U+0080–07FF uses 110xxxxx 10xxxxxx. The three-byte form starts 1110xxxx; the four-byte form starts 11110xxx. Each remaining byte starts 10 and supplies six payload bits. Choose the shortest valid length. Reject missing continuations, overlong forms, surrogate values and code points above U+10FFFF.

title: Branch offsets and jump targets
description: A branch carries a signed 16-bit word displacement from the instruction following the branch. With branch address P and stored displacement d, target = P + 4 + 4d. In J format, j/jal take the top four bits of P + 4, append the 26-bit index, then append two zero bits for alignment. jr instead takes its target directly from a register. The J-format address calculation is supporting Green Sheet detail for the short Week 8 introduction.
